question:
Select the most appropriate option that can replace the bracketed word segment in the following sentence.

Classical buildings in ancient Greek and Roman times were (characteristically built) from marble or some other attractive, durable stone.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"characteristically built"** means something that is typically constructed in a particular way, often reflecting the defining qualities or features of the time period or style. (विशिष्ट रूप से निर्मित)

 
 
• **Example: **The houses in this region are **characteristically built **with sloping roofs to withstand heavy snowfall.
 
 
 
• **"Typically built" **refers to the common or usual method of construction, implying that it follows a standard or common pattern. (आम तौर पर निर्मित)
 
 
• **Example: **Modern skyscrapers are **typically built **with steel and glass for both strength and aesthetic appeal.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that** "characteristically built"** and **"typically built"** are** synonymous **in the context of the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fascinating to build** (आकर्षक बनाने के लिए): Refers to something that is extremely interesting or delightful to construct.

 
 
• **Example:** The ancient pyramids would have been fascinating to build with the technology available at the time.
 
 
 
• **Strange build** (अजीब निर्माण): Refers to something constructed in an unusual or peculiar manner.
 
 
• **Example: **The artist's house has a strange build with odd angles and unexpected shapes.
 
 
 
• **Mainly having been built** (मुख्य रूप से बनाया गया): Refers to something that was constructed primarily or mostly in a particular way.
 
 
• **Example:** The ancient city was mainly having been built with mud bricks due to the lack of stone.
